description:
*Investors and First Time Buyer*

This sleek, modern studio apartment in the vibrant heart of Leicester City Centre offers a superb opportunity for city living at its finest. Located on the first floor of the popular Squirrel Building on Colton Street, this stylish property is perfect for professionals, students, or investors seeking a central location. Thoughtfully designed with contemporary finishes and an open-plan layout, it provides all the essentials for comfortable, low-maintenance living.

Key Features:

Prime City Centre Location – Positioned on Colton Street, with easy access to Leicester's best shops, restaurants, and cultural attractions.

Modern Studio Layout – Open-plan design with a smart, functional layout, maximizing space and natural light.

Contemporary Kitchen – Fully-fitted kitchen area with integrated appliances and ample storage, ideal for home cooking and entertaining.

Stylish Shower Room – Modern bathroom suite with a walk-in shower, sleek tiling, and quality fixtures.

Convenient First Floor Position – Easily accessible, with secure entry to the building.

Excellent Transport Links – Just a short walk to Leicester Train Station and main bus routes, connecting you quickly with the rest of the city and beyond.

Investment Potential – Desirable location with strong rental demand, ideal for investors seeking attractive returns.

Arrange a viewing today to experience this modern, city-centre lifestyle.
